component.name: Gantry
component.summary: Gantt charts that open and save GanttProject files

description.p: Gantry plans projects as Gantt charts, and works with the files GanttProject uses, so you can move a project between the two without losing anything.

ul.li: Opens and saves GanttProject (.gan) files; whatever Gantry doesn't use (column layout, custom columns, baselines) is kept as it was
Tasks in a tree, with dependencies of all four kinds and lag, milestones, progress, notes and colours
Drag bars to move them, drag their edge to change the length, drag a ring to link tasks; every change can be undone
Working days, days off and holidays; the critical path; late tasks
People with roles, rates, time off and an over-booking warning
Export to PNG, SVG, PDF and CSV, with your school's name and emblem if you like

description.p: The task table can be resized by dragging the grip beside it.
First release: GanttProject-compatible Gantt charts with drag-and-drop editing, dependencies, resources, working calendar, critical path, exports and the school's branding.
